g.title: J_AC
g.text: 230 V AC from the installation. Touch-safe block inside the mains compartment; part pending enclosure design.

g.title: F0
g.text: 5 x 20 mm in a touch-protected holder, in the L conductor ahead of both modules.

g.title: PSU5
g.text: Mean Well, 5 V / 6 A, Class II, screw terminals. Sole 5 V source.

g.title: PSU12
g.text: Mean Well, 12 V / 2.5 A, Class II, screw terminals. Strike rail, isolated from the 5 V rail.

g.title: PE1
g.text: Stud on the metal backplate. Single bonding point for the supply PE, the front plate, and the 5 V return.

g.title: TB2
g.text: Two 5-pole lever connectors linked by a 50 mm 20 AWG bridge, in 221-500 carriers. 5 V return star point and PE bond.

g.title: FRONT
g.text: Ring terminal under a serrated washer.

g.title: TB1
g.text: One 5-pole lever connector in a 221-500 carrier. 5 V star point.

g.title: J8
g.text: Zero 2 W. Pin 1 is nearest the microSD slot, inner row (square pad on the underside). 5 V enters on pin 2 and returns on pin 6.

g.title: U1
g.text: Adafruit 3006. C1 470 uF and C2 100 nF across VIN/GND. Signals and speaker are in wiring-audio.

g.title: F2
g.text: Inline in the JD-VCC lead, insulated with heat-shrink.

g.title: U3
g.text: Retained module; E4 open. JD-VCC jumper absent. COM1/NO1 switch the isolated 12 V strike rail. COM2/NO2 form the potential-free gate contact. Logic pins are in wiring-io.

g.title: HSW1
g.text: Bought logic-level low-side switch module with gate pull-down, for example AOD4184 based. DC+ passes straight to OUT+; OUT- is switched to DC-. Control pins are in wiring-io.

g.title: HTR1
g.text: 5 V film heater, about 3 W, bonded to the camera and microphone carrier.

g.title: F1
g.text: Fast, rated 32 V DC or more, in the 12 V+ lead to COM1.

g.title: JOUT1
g.text: To the effeff 118 A7 strike. D1 1N4007 at the coil: cathode STRIKE+, anode STRIKE-. External cable length is installation-specific.

g.title: JOUT2
g.text: Potential-free contact for the gate controller start input. 30 V DC / 1 A design limit.
